record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: For a Fano variety X, is the Gibbs-stability invariant gamma(X) > 1 exactly when X is K-stable, and gamma(X) >= 1 exactly when X is K-semistable?

evidence.quote:
Conjecture 15 (Berman). For a Fano variety X, γ(X) > 1 (resp. ≥ 1) if and only if X is
K-stable (resp. K-semistable).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano variety, that is, a normal projective variety with at worst klt singularities such that $-K_X$ is an ample $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier divisor. For each integer $N$ such that $-NK_X$ is Cartier and very ample, choose a basis of $H^0(X, -NK_X)$ to embed $X^N := X \times \cdots \times X$ ($N$ factors), and consider the natural $\mathbb{Q}$-divisor $D_N$ on $X^N$ associated with the Vandermonde-type section
$$\det\bigl(s_i(x_j)\bigr)_{1\le i,j \le \dim H^0(X,-NK_X)}$$
(the "free-energy" divisor arising from the $N$-particle Gibbs measure with inverse temperature determined by $-K_X$). Define the Gibbs-stability invariant
$$\gamma(X) := \lim_{N\to\infty} \mathrm{lct}\bigl(X^N, \tfrac{1}{N}D_N\bigr),$$
where $\mathrm{lct}$ denotes the log canonical threshold (the limit is known to exist).

Recall that $X$ is K-stable (resp. K-semistable) if for every nontrivial special test configuration $(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{L})$ for $(X,-K_X)$, the Donaldson–Futaki invariant $\mathrm{DF}(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{L})$ is positive (resp. nonnegative).

Prove or disprove: $\gamma(X) > 1$ if and only if $X$ is K-stable, and $\gamma(X) \ge 1$ if and only if $X$ is K-semistable.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (due to Berman) remains open in general. Fujita (2015, Compositio Math.) established that Berman–Gibbs (semi)stability implies K-(semi)stability for $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano varieties, providing one direction. The reverse implication is still conjectural; recent work by Berman and collaborators (2025) extends the framework to Gibbs polystability and proves results in special cases (e.g., log Fano curves), but the full equivalence remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On Berman–Gibbs stability and K-stability of Q-Fano varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Berman-Gibbs stability implies K-stability for Q-Fano varieties.
status_evidence.claim: One direction (Gibbs stability ⇒ K-stability) proved by Fujita.

status_evidence.title: Gibbs polystability of Fano manifolds, stability thresholds and symmetry breaking
status_evidence.snippet: We conjecture that Gibbs polystability is equivalent to K-polystability; verified for log Fano curves and special cases.
status_evidence.claim: Full equivalence remains conjectural; partial results in special cases.
